host.description: Hostname or IP address of the VirtualBox host system (where VBoxHeadless/VirtualBox runs)

port.description: TCP port for the VirtualBox web service (VRDE or HTTP API). Default is 18083 for VBoxHeadless VRDE, or 18083/18093 for WebSockets API.

username.description: Username for authenticating to the VirtualBox host (used with VBOX_PASSWORD)

password.description: Password for the VirtualBox user. For security, consider storing in a protected file with restricted permissions.

ssh_key_path.description: Path to SSH private key for key-based authentication (alternative to password). Leave empty to use password auth.

timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for power operations (on/off/status) before timing out.

extra_opts.description: Additional command-line flags to pass to VBoxManage (e.g., ['--nologo', '--quiet']).

vms.description: List of virtual machines known to this fence agent (used for status monitoring and explicit targeting). Each entry identifies a VM by UUID or name.

name.description: Friendly name of the VM (for logging/labeling).

uuid.description: VirtualBox VM UUID (required for reliable identification).
